excluded_components.name: omniroute-codex-docker
excluded_components.reason: Explicitly excluded from the JEV Codex integration stack (epic #2).

integration_host.role: Integration host: one pinned build, one isolated profile, one native adapter per host boundary.

component_pins.name: codex-plaintext-collab
component_pins.role: Plaintext inter-agent collaboration patch and update-safe tooling.

component_pins.name: jev-context-fabric
component_pins.role: Canonical capture, retrieval/hydration, MCP, and jev-bus registry owner.

component_pins.name: jev-prune-kit
component_pins.role: Duplicate-read pruning stage and native prune/compaction gate machine.

component_pins.name: jev-sentinel
component_pins.role: Boundary observation, screening, veto precedence, and incident records.

component_pins.name: jev-codex-approval
component_pins.role: Native Codex approval preflight adapter with Guardian fallback.

patch_order.name: codex-native-approval-adapter
patch_order.anchor_note: The upstream inspected blobs are byte-identical at codex_pin.commit, so the guarded anchors resolve; the adapter manifest's exact-commit guard still must be re-pinned to codex_pin.commit before compilation.

python.notes: Components are zero-dependency at runtime; the integration layer and verifier use only the standard library.

node.notes: Required only for adapters and node --test suites.

runtime_requirements.native_build_note: The system has no OpenSSL development files; the pinned build enables the vendored OpenSSL feature on codex-cli, matching the plaintext-collab build recipe.

supported_platforms.notes: Reference build platform for the isolated profile.
No macOS host available in this environment; refused rather than assumed.
No Windows host available; refused rather than assumed.

JEV_ENABLE_FABRIC_CAPTURE.effect: Enable canonical evidence capture before any context projection.

JEV_ENABLE_BUS_PROJECTION.effect: Enable outgoing-request projection through the single native jev-bus boundary.

JEV_ENABLE_APPROVAL_PREFLIGHT.effect: Enable the native approval preflight inside eligible synchronous review attempts only.

JEV_ENFORCEMENT_MODE.effect: Global enforcement posture. shadow observes only; enforce maps configured outcomes to host veto behavior.

JEV_ALLOW_REMOTE_INFERENCE.effect: Separate consent gate for any remote model call. Optional remote inference stays disabled unless explicitly authorized and budgeted.

owns: the single native adapter for each host boundary

ownership_boundaries.host_change: applied by codex-jev at build time, never edited in place

credentials.policy: Every component keeps its own credential file. No shared credential, no cross-component token reuse, and no credential in fixtures, logs, or committed records.
credentials.remote_consent: Remote inference requires both JEV_ALLOW_REMOTE_INFERENCE and the owning component's own consent configuration; joining a chain never starts a paid call.

unsupported_combinations: A platform outside supported_platforms with a non-unsupported status.
Any component pin whose declared artifact hash does not match the checkout.
jev-bus vendored copies that are not byte-identical between jev-context-fabric and jev-prune-kit.
Remote inference enabled without JEV_ALLOW_REMOTE_INFERENCE and component consent.
